doc.text: Welcome to our evening broadcast of "Myths and Stories News".
Without further ado, here's the news...
doc.headline: Uncanny Fish Event
doc.text: What a surprise... Funny Fish was once again spotted fiending for some grub.
As a reminder, we ask that you not leave any food or drink unattended near Funny Fish's hunting ground.
Funny Fish can smell your food, and will dawdle if it catches a whiff of your delectable treats.
Your negligence endangers your life, as well as the lives of your community members.
Well, that's all the time we have today!
Tune in next week for another episode of "Myth and Story's News"!
